name: active
label: Active
help: Turn it off to pause the link, or on to reopen it.

name: password
label: Password
help: Leave it empty to keep the current password, or map `erase` to remove it.

name: expiresAt
label: Expires at
help: Leave it empty to keep the current date, or map `erase` so that the link never expires.

name: maxDownloads
label: Maximum downloads
help: Leave it empty to keep the current limit, or map `erase` to remove it.
